lines.t: They were waiting on a lion, crowns on their sleeves,
Pharisees plotting in the shadows of thieves.
Quoting all the scrolls while their hearts loved war,
Standing with the rulers yelling “Crucify!” more.
Wanted Son of David with a sword in His hand,
But YahuShua came lowly, as the Lamb for the land.
Despised and rejected in their holy robes,
Pierced their only Hope, crowned Him with thorns.
You were waiting on the roar, got the silence of the Lamb,
Thought He’d crush Rome, but He crushed your sin, not man.
You crowned Him with thorns, now He’s crowned in blazing flame,
Lion from the Temple, He is coming in His Name.
Wrath of the Lamb, all your empires ‘bout to fall,
You served satan, now you shake when you hear the trumpet call.
You were waiting on the roar, but the Lamb already bled,
Now the Lion’s at the door and He’s coming for your head.[Verse 2]
“Woe to you teachers,” He exposed their pride,
Modern Pharisees still white‑washing the outside.
Twisting up the Scriptures, built their system in the sand,
Preaching a molded messiah, not the Lamb of God’s command.
Sold out the truth for tradition and fame,
Mixed holy days with idols, stamped His Name.
One broken word made the whole Law fall,
Now the cup you filled is the wrath you call.
You broke one word, now you’re shackled in chains,
Turned grace to permission and honored your stains.
You flirted with the world, with the dragon’s throne,
Now the One you pierced is returning for His own.
You were waiting on the roar, got the silence of the Lamb,
Thought He’d crush Rome, but He crushed your sin, not man.
You crowned Him with thorns, now He’s crowned in blazing flame,
Lion from the Temple, He is coming in His Name.
Wrath of the Lamb, all your empires ‘bout to fall,
You served satan, now you shake when you hear the trumpet call.
You were waiting on the roar, but the Lamb already bled,
Now the Lion’s at the door and He’s coming for your head.[Bridge – EDM Drop / Chant]
“Kiss the Son! Kiss the Son!”
Mountains start to tremble when the Day has come.
From death into life or from light into grave,
Passover blood is the only way you’re saved.
“I am risen” shakes the iron of the earth,
Lion of Judah roaring over second birth.
Every throne, every power in His hand,
This world is a tree with its fruit turned black,
Every root in the soil pulling judgment back.
You murdered the babies, filled the ground with blood,
Turned justice to wormwood, truth into mud.
Now the Holy One rises from His dwelling place,
Twenty‑one strikes on a rebel race.
Winepress deep where the proud ones dine,
Wrath of the Lamb in the river of wine.
He’s the Passover sign, blood over the posts,
High Priest, Mercy Seat, Commander of hosts.
You mocked His meekness, spit in His face,
Same YahuShua’s gonna level this place.
Heaven rolls back, every mountain laid low,
Islands disappear in the blaze of His glow.
If you love this world, you can share its doom,
When the Lion leaves the Temple, Sheol makes room.
You were waiting on the roar, got the silence of the Lamb,
But the silence gets shattered by the Great I AM.
Trumpets in the sky, kingdoms breaking like glass,
Day of burning heat gonna scorch up the grass.
Better run to the Lamb ‘fore the Lion appears,
Or drown in your blood and your Babylon fears.
He’s the Ladder, the Door, only Ark that will stand,
Lion‑Lamb, YahuShua, ruler over every land.
